subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object layer: a set of singly/doubly linked list containers over heap-allocated nodes (24-byte string nodes, 56-byte frame nodes), a scene render batch with 116-byte slot records and its descriptor (render-list iteration, per-frame buffer clear), mesh geometry/bbox computation with an animation-clock blend path, mesh-data dual-format destruction, a parameter-table copy consumer, a network packet payload reader, a Bink video frame decoder, a font texture sheet analyzer, and several thin flag/timer/working-index helpers with unknown owners.

summary: Reconstructs the generic runtime object layer from 23 validated functions. Three DERIVED classes carry the packet's named owners: SceneRenderBatch (0x0054EED0) inserts triangles into a 116-byte-slot batch and shares the this+0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8 descriptor region with the GUESS RenderListManager (0x0054F710) and RenderBufferEntryManager (0x0054FAE0); Mesh (0x0054D9F0) computes per-node bounding boxes and an animation-clock blend factor through nested GUESS MeshPart and MeshAnimation records; MeshDataDualFormat (0x00550F70) tears down two storage formats selected by format flags at +0x0; and BinkVideoDecoder (0x00551DD0) drives the four-pointer Bink API global block. One GUESS StringListOwner hosts three structurally identical 24-byte string-node appends (0x00549020, 0x005492F0, 0x005493B0) that differ only in their head offset (0xE8/0xF8/0xFC), with a shared StringNode24 node type. Remaining GUESS classes cover a tree-list mover, a 56-byte frame-node list, a doubly linked list, a triple-float query, a flag-bit clearer, a float-struct table initializer, two forwarding wrappers, a packet payload reader, a working-index setter, a parameter-table consumer, a flag/timer owner, a timer-capped node walker, and a font texture sheet analyzer. Several this+0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8 and this+0x13C offsets recur across different classes; common ownership is not proven, so equal offsets on different objects are kept as separate fields.

function_roles.role: Appends a 24-byte string node to the string list headed at this+0xE8: walks node next pointers at +0x14 to the tail (or treats the list as empty), allocates 24 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zero-initializes the node via ShortComputation_8e00, strcpy's the caller string into the node buffer, links the node in, and returns the result of the sub_589901 normalize/register call.

Walks the node list headed at this+0xE8 advancing through node+0x14; for each node runs RecursiveTreeStringSearch (0x0054BC60) to find a matching child, and when one is found moves it from the source list rooted at *this (LinkedListRemove 0x005452B0) to the target list (DoublyLinkedListAppend 0x005490B0). Returns the last append result.

Appends a new 56-byte node to the singly linked list headed at this+0xF0 (next pointers at node+0x34). Walks to the tail when the head exists, allocates 56 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zero-initializes each node via StructZeroInitWithBaseCall (0x0055D200), links it in, and returns the new node (or 0 on allocation failure).

Appends a 24-byte string node to the string list headed at this+0xF8: identical walk/alloc/init/copy/link pattern to 0x00549020, but with a different head offset. Allocates 24 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes via ShortComputation_8e00, strcpy's the string, and returns the result of sub_589901.

Appends a 24-byte string node to the string list headed at this+0xFC: identical walk/alloc/init/copy/link pattern to 0x00549020, with a third head offset. Allocates 24 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes via ShortComputation_8e00, strcpy's the string, and returns the result of sub_589901.

Appends a node a2 to the tail of a doubly linked list headed at this+0x100 (node prev at +0x100, next at +0x104). On a non-empty list it walks to the tail and links a2 after it; on an empty list it sets this+0x100 = a2 and zeroes both a2 links. Returns the previous head, or the new node on an empty list.

Triple float field query: writes this[11] (0x2C) to *a2, this[12] (0x30) to *a3 and this[13] (0x34) to *a4 when the corresponding output pointers are non-null, then returns a4. Called by DualMatrixTransformMultiply (0x0054B530) on the frame path.

Clears the low two flag bits (0x2 and 0x4) of the flag dword at this+0x3C by AND-ing with 0xFFFFFFF9. Unconditional thiscall with no callees; dispatched per element by sub_4A3390 and PerElementConditionalActionDispatcher (0x004A34A0) on the frame path.

Initializes a 256-entry table of float structs at global unk_8BF740 by calling F_10FloatStructInitializer (0x0053B130) once per entry, advancing 26 DWORDs (104 bytes) per step, then returns the last initializer result.

Computes the axis-aligned bounding box and bounding sphere of a mesh: walks the mesh-node list (head this+0x13C, node processed flag +0x4, next +0x24), and per part (count this+0x118, base this+0x11C) transforms vertices through the global dword_8B8F24 device vtable, accumulates per-axis extrema, dispatches primitive handlers (0x0055E320/0x0055DA50/0x0055D900 and render-flag handler 0x0055EB30), writes eight bbox corners at this+0x1C..0x78, axis centers at this+0xDC/0xE0/0xE4 and sphere radius at this+0x18. The animated path reads blended vertex data through the animation struct at this+0x144, advances its clock (anim+0x8) by the frame delta at dword_8B8F28, clamps to the duration (anim+0x4) by mode (anim+0x0), and interpolates when the blend flag is set.

Thin stdcall forwarding wrapper with no local logic: forwards a1 and a2 unchanged to ConditionalFieldSetter_0d40. Called by UIElementBitfieldStateSetter (0x0054BDC0), sub_54CA00 (0x0054CA00) and MeshBoundingBoxComputation (0x0054D9F0) as the mesh part begin-processing callback.

Thin stdcall forwarding wrapper: passes a pointer a1 and a char flag a2 straight to ConditionalBitmaskCleanup and returns its result unchanged. Called by the same three callers as 0x0054E0E0 as the mesh part finish-processing callback.

Inserts triangles into the scene render-batch slot array: iterates the source triangle list, transforms u16 vertex indices to world positions through the dword_8B8F24 vtable, rejects far triangles, scans batch slots (116-byte/29-dword stride) for a free one, classifies the dominant contact axis, runs F_2D3DTrianglePointTest (0x0054EB40), and fills the winning slot with state, parent pointers, material, contact normal, interpolated position and distance; then notifies consumers via SingleFunctionCallWrapper_9a30 (0x00559A30). Returns the number of triangles inserted.

Iterates a scene render-list descriptor (element count this+0x1E4, element array this+0x1E8, both reached through descriptor pointer this+0x1E0). Elements whose first word equals 2 are only counted; every other element receives two D3D-style transform calls through the dword_8B8F24 vtable slot +4. Returns the number of type-2 elements, or 0 when the count is not positive.

Reads a 64-byte payload out of a packet buffer for a caller-supplied slot index: loads the packet handle at this[0x1E0], rejects a null handle, an out-of-range index, or an entry whose present flag (bit 0) is clear, then copies the payload from the matched 116-byte entry into the output buffer and returns 1 or 0. Structural twin of the NetworkPacketDataWriter cluster. Called by VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator (0x00459AE0) and CollisionDetectionSystem (0x004EA970).

Resets render buffer entries for the next frame: clears the active/dirty flag bit 0 (entry offset 0) and zeroes the status field (entry offset 0x40), either on every entry (when index a2 equals the 0x8000000 bulk sentinel) or on the single entry selected by a2. Entry array and element count come from the descriptor at this+0x1E0..0x1E8.

Trivial field setter: stores argument a2 into this[27] (byte offset 0x6C) and returns that same value. Invoked during DirectX mesh vertex-buffer parsing (0x00547B40) and material processing (sub_54CA00, 0x0054CA00) to track the current working index/slot.

Destructor for loaded mesh data supporting two storage formats selected by flags at this+0x0 (bit 0x1 material-block, bit 0x2 texture/animation-block). Releases per-block sub-allocations (RefcountDecrement 0x005507D0, sub_550810, EmptyStub_7470, ArrayOfStructDestructorWithCountdown 0x00550820, FreeWrapper_7bcf) and frees the top-level strided arrays, returning 0 on every path.

Copies parameter data from a parameter table into per-entity data blocks: clamps the selected data index (this+0x8), iterates the per-entity block array (count this+0x14, base this+0x18, 136-byte stride), and for each block whose first dword is not 255 copies the parameter entry selected by block type and index (a float triplet via sub_53B4C0 plus three dwords) into the block. Sets flag bit 0x10000 at this+0x4 on completion and, when a2 is non-null, clears a bitmask via BitmaskClear (0x0054B330).

Flag-word mutation with a timer restart: replaces this[1] (this+0x4) with (this[1] & 0xFFFE0FFF) | 0x2000, then restarts a timer through TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter using this[0] and returns the timer-start result.

Walks a linked list whose head pointer is stored at this+0x13C, following each node's next pointer at node+0x24. For every node whose time-cap pointer at node+0x1C is non-null, calls TimerBasedStateUpdateWithCap (0x005514C0) on that node with this as the second argument. Runs inside SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform (0x005569F0).

Bink video frame decoder (thiscall): BinkWait/BinkDoFrame/BinkNextFrame on the Bink handle at this+0, advances and wraps the frame index this[1] modulo the total frame count read from the Bink header at *this+8, maps the render-path flag a2[12] through a jump table into a copy-flag word, ORs high bits from a5 (0x20 sets 0x80000000, 0x10 sets 0x60000000), locks a surface via ThunkWithArgReorder (0x00543210), copies the frame with BinkCopyToBuffer, clears bit 0x400 of a2[6], and returns the surface-unlock result (0x00543230).

Analyzes a font texture sheet surface to derive glyph cell layout and rewrite the pixel transparency mask: reads the surface object at this+0x64 (width +0x20, height +0x1C, pitch +0x28, pixel format +0x30, flags +0x18), accesses its 16-bit pixel data via ThunkWithArgReorder, scans for sentinel colors to find horizontal/vertical cell divisions, stores key colors at this+0x28/0x2C/0x30 and cell counts/pitches at this+0x34..0x40, computes the total cell count at this+0x44, builds an 8-byte per-cell lookup table at this+0x6D, walks every pixel rewriting alpha-mask bits (setting the +0x18 surface flag 0x800), and finalizes the surface through ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230 (0x00543230).

classes.name: StringNode24
classes.responsibility: 24-byte string-list node: a string buffer plus a next pointer at +0x14. Allocated 24 bytes by the shared allocator, zero-initialized by ShortComputation_8e00, payload written by strcpy, and finalized through sub_589901. The node type is shared by the three string-list append methods.

classes.name: StringListOwner
classes.responsibility: Owner object of up to three singly linked string lists headed at this+0xE8, this+0xF8 and this+0xFC, each appending 24-byte StringNode24 nodes. The head offsets differ between the three append methods; whether they are three lists of one object or three sibling object types is not proven, so each head is kept as a separate field. The container pointers at this+0x10C/0x110 (and this+0xFC read as a container in 0x00549020) are recorded separately.

classes.name: TreeStringListMover
classes.responsibility: Moves matching tree nodes between a source list rooted at *this and a target list managed by this. Iterates the node list headed at this+0xE8, searches each node's tree via RecursiveTreeStringSearch, and moves matches with LinkedListRemove/DoublyLinkedListAppend. The target list's container type is not identified.

classes.name: FrameNode56List
classes.responsibility: Singly linked list of 56-byte nodes (next pointer at +0x34), headed at this+0xF0, with a container pointer at this+0x124 through which the node next field is reached. Appends one node via 0x005491D0.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked list with head at this+0x100; nodes carry prev at +0x100 and next at +0x104. Node links are reached through the container pointer at this+0x204. One append method 0x0054A270.

classes.name: TripleFloatQuery
classes.responsibility: Object exposing three adjacent float fields (this+0x2C/0x30/0x34) through a conditional triple-output query. Whether the triple is a vector, scalar set or something else is not evidenced. One method 0x0054B4A0.

classes.name: FlagBitState
classes.responsibility: Holder of a flag dword at this+0x3C whose low two bits are cleared per element on the frame path by 0x0054C190. The meaning of the cleared bits is unknown. The owner class is unknown.

classes.name: FloatStructTableInit
classes.responsibility: One-shot initializer for a global 256-entry float-struct table at unk_8BF740 with a 26-DWORD stride. Only ever passes the table to F_10FloatStructInitializer. One method 0x0054C2D0; the owning class is unknown.

classes.name: Mesh
classes.responsibility: Mesh object holding render flags (0x14), the output axis-aligned bounding box (corners 0x1C..0x78), axis centers (0xDC/0xE0/0xE4), bounding-sphere radius (0x18), a part array (count 0x118, base 0x11C), a mesh-node list (head 0x13C) and an animation struct pointer (0x144). Computes its bounding box and sphere and drives the animation clock through 0x0054D9F0.

classes.name: MeshPart
classes.responsibility: Mesh-node record in the mesh-node list headed at Mesh.0x13C: a processed-flag word at +0x4, a transform stride at +0x18, and the next-node pointer at +0x24.

classes.name: MeshAnimation
classes.responsibility: Animation clock structure reached through Mesh.0x144: mode at +0x0, duration at +0x4, clock at +0x8 and a blend-offset region index at +0xC. The blend interpolation also reads a field at offset 0x11C inside the blend-offset region (base *(*(this+0x144)+0xC)).

classes.name: MeshPartProcessingCallbacks
classes.responsibility: Two thin forwarding wrappers invoked per mesh part as begin/finish processing callbacks by MeshBoundingBoxComputation (0x0054D9F0), UIElementBitfieldStateSetter (0x0054BDC0) and sub_54CA00 (0x0054CA00). 0x0054E0E0 forwards to ConditionalFieldSetter_0d40; 0x0054E0F0 forwards to ConditionalBitmaskCleanup. The targets' identities and a recorded global read of dword_8B78A0 are unresolved.

classes.name: SceneRenderBatch
classes.responsibility: Scene render batch holding a descriptor region (this+0x1E0 descriptor, this+0x1E4 count, this+0x1E8 slot array) and a position triple at this+0x204. Inserts world-space triangles into 116-byte slots via 0x0054EED0 on the frame path from SceneBatchRenderCheck (0x0054F5C0).

classes.name: RenderBatchSlot
classes.responsibility: 116-byte (29-dword) slot record in the SceneRenderBatch slot array (base *(this+0x1E8)): state word at +0x00, transform data at +0x18/+0x28/+0x2C/+0x30, parent scene at +0x34, reserved zeros at +0x38/+0x50, op-context at +0x3C, triangle-list pointer at +0x40, material float at +0x44, slot index at +0x48, source triangle pointer at +0x4C, contact normal at +0x58..0x60, interpolated position at +0x64..0x6C, and a Euclidean distance at +0x70.

classes.name: RenderListManager
classes.responsibility: Iterates a scene render-list descriptor (descriptor pointer this+0x1E0, element count this+0x1E4, element array this+0x1E8; elements 116 bytes apart with a type word at +0x00). Counts type-2 elements and issues two transform calls per other element through the dword_8B8F24 vtable. Shares the this+0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8 descriptor region with SceneRenderBatch and RenderBufferEntryManager; common ownership is not proven.

classes.name: RenderBufferEntryManager
classes.responsibility: Per-frame render buffer entry reset: clears entry flag bit 0 (offset 0) and the status field (offset 0x40) for one entry or for all entries (index sentinel 0x8000000). Entry array and count come from the descriptor at this+0x1E0..0x1E8. Shares the descriptor region offsets with SceneRenderBatch and RenderListManager.

classes.name: NetworkPacketReader
classes.responsibility: Reads a fixed 64-byte payload from a packet buffer by slot index: the packet handle lives at this[0x1E0], entries are 116 bytes with a present flag (bit 0) at offset 0 and the payload at offset 0x34. One method 0x0054FA90, called by physics and collision consumers.

classes.name: WorkingIndexHolder
classes.responsibility: Holds a current working index/slot in this[27] (offset 0x6C), written and returned by 0x0054FC70 during DirectX mesh vertex-buffer and material processing. The field's exact meaning is inferred from caller names only.

classes.name: MeshDataDualFormat
classes.responsibility: Loaded mesh data supporting two storage formats selected by format flags at +0x0 (bit 0x1 material-block format, bit 0x2 texture/animation-block format). Material format holds a block count at +0xC and material array at +0x10; texture format holds a group count at +0x14 and texture group array at +0x18. Torn down by the destructor 0x00550F70.

classes.name: ParameterTableConsumer
classes.responsibility: Consumes parameter data from a parameter table into per-entity 136-byte data blocks: flags at +0x4, selected data index at +0x8, block count at +0x14, block array at +0x18, parameter-table pointer at +0x1C, entry-table base at +0x2C, table count/aux at +0x30, and block copy slots at +0x4C/0x50/0x54. Copies a float triplet plus three dwords per block via 0x00551390.

classes.name: FlagTimerOwner
classes.responsibility: Owner of a timer pointer at +0x0 and a flag word at +0x4. 0x005514A0 masks a flag region and sets bit 0x2000, then restarts the timer. Called from 0x005514C0 and 0x00551800.

classes.name: NodeTimerWalker
classes.responsibility: Walks a list headed at this+0x13C and applies a timer-capped state update to nodes with a configured time cap. Nodes carry the cap pointer at +0x1C and the next pointer at +0x24 (base *(this+0x160)). One method 0x00551760, called from SceneNodeStateUpdateWithTransform (0x005569F0).

classes.name: TimerNode
classes.responsibility: Node in the NodeTimerWalker list (base *(this+0x160)): a time-cap pointer at +0x1C and the next-node pointer at +0x24.

classes.name: BinkVideoDecoder
classes.responsibility: Bink video decoder object: Bink handle at +0x0, wrapped frame index at +0x4, with the total frame count read from the Bink header at *this+8 (obj+0x8). 0x00551DD0 waits/decodes/advances frames and copies the decoded frame into a caller surface using the four-pointer Bink API block at globals 0x0059E340..0x0059E34C and the copy-flag jump table at global 0x00551E94.

classes.name: FontTextureSheetAnalyzer
classes.responsibility: Analyzes a font texture sheet surface (pointer at this+0x64) to derive glyph cell layout and rewrite pixel transparency: key colors at this+0x28/0x2C/0x30, cell counts at this+0x34/0x38, cell pitches at this+0x3C/0x40, total cell count at this+0x44, and an 8-byte per-cell lookup table at this+0x6D. The surface exposes flags at +0x18, height at +0x1C, width at +0x20, pitch at +0x28 and pixel format at +0x30 (base *(this+0x64)). One method 0x00552BA0.

state_machines.name: MeshAnimationClock
transitions: forward: each frame tick advances the clock (anim+0x8) by the frame delta from dword_8B8F28
forward: clock clamps to the duration (anim+0x4); on completion the mesh flags at this+0x14 are updated and the clock resets
reverse: mode equals reverse; clock update is gated by a nonzero part count (this+0x118)

interfaces.name: ID3DVertexTransformService
interfaces.purpose: Service object whose vtable lives at global dword_8B8F24; slots +0 (cdecl), +4 (cdecl) and +32 (thiscall) are dispatched to transform vertex data, read positions and compute distances. Used by Mesh (0x0054D9F0), SceneRenderBatch (0x0054EED0) and RenderListManager (0x0054F710). Slot semantics are inferred from call shape; the identity of the service is unknown.

interfaces.name: IBinkApi
interfaces.purpose: Four-function Bink API block at globals 0x0059E340 (BinkWait), 0x0059E344 (BinkDoFrame), 0x0059E348 (BinkNextFrame) and 0x0059E34C (BinkCopyToBuffer), driven by BinkVideoDecoder. Function identities are DERIVED from call shape and Bink conventions.

interfaces.name: IHeapAllocatorService
interfaces.purpose: Shared allocation/free service: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03) allocates node/block sizes and FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) releases them. Used by the string-list, frame-node-list and mesh-data-destructor paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringListNode24Layout
compatibility_contracts.description: String-list nodes are 24-byte allocations with the next pointer at +0x14 and a string buffer written by strcpy after ShortComputation_8e00 zero-init; the node is finalized through sub_589901 (0x00589901) whose result becomes the append function's return value. A replacement must allocate exactly 24 bytes, walk the +0x14 chain, and return the normalize/register result.

compatibility_contracts.name: RenderBatchSlotLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Scene render-batch slots are 116-byte (29-dword) records: state word at +0x00, parent scene at +0x34, op-context at +0x3C, triangle-list pointer at +0x40, material float at +0x44, slot index at +0x48, source triangle at +0x4C, contact normal at +0x58..0x60, interpolated position at +0x64..0x6C and distance at +0x70. Occupied slots carry state value 1; state value 6 is skipped by the inserter. The same 116-byte stride and type word at +0x00 drive the render-list iteration.

compatibility_contracts.name: MeshBoundingBoxOutput
compatibility_contracts.description: ComputeMeshBoundingBox writes the eight bounding-box corners at this+0x1C..0x78, the three axis center coordinates at this+0xDC/0xE0/0xE4 and the bounding-sphere radius (sqrt of sum of half-extent squares) at this+0x18. A replacement rendering or culling consumer relies on this exact output layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: MeshDataDualFormatStorage
compatibility_contracts.description: Loaded mesh data selects its storage format by flags at +0x0: bit 0x1 selects the material-block format (block count at +0xC, array at +0x10) and bit 0x2 selects the texture/animation-block format (group count at +0x14, array at +0x18). The destructor must release both layouts and return 0 on every path.

compatibility_contracts.name: BinkFramePipeline
compatibility_contracts.description: The Bink decoder drives a four-function API block at globals 0x0059E340 (wait), 0x0059E344 (do-frame), 0x0059E348 (next-frame) and 0x0059E34C (copy-to-buffer). Frame index advances as (index+1) mod total-frame-count read from the Bink header at *handle+8. A replacement executable must reproduce the wait/decode/advance/copy ordering and the copy-flag assembly (jump-table base ORed with 0x80000000/0x60000000 from the a5 flag bits 0x20/0x10).

compatibility_contracts.name: RenderBufferBulkClearSentinel
compatibility_contracts.description: Render-buffer entry clear uses the index value 0x8000000 as a bulk sentinel: passing it clears every entry (each entry's flag bit 0 at +0x00 and status at +0x40), otherwise only the single selected entry is cleared. The descriptor (pointer at this+0x1E0, count at this+0x1E4, array at this+0x1E8) must be preserved.

unresolved: StringListOwner: this+0xFC is read as the list head by appendStringCopyNode (0x005493B0) but as a read-only container pointer by appendStringNode (0x00549020); the packet does not prove whether these are three lists of one object or three sibling object types, so the heads are kept as separate fields.
StringNode24: the exact semantics of sub_589901 (0x00589901) - normalization vs registration - are not grounded in this packet.

FrameNode56List: the container field at this+0x124 does not appear in the raw source; parameter a2 of 0x005491D0 is unused, and whether the head at this+0xF0 and the node next at +0x34 are separate allocations or one object is not established.

DoublyLinkedList: the node layout (prev at +0x100, next at +0x104) is inferred from raw-source offsets 256/260 only; the container pointer this+0x204 is an existing-analysis interpretation not directly expressed in the raw body.
TripleFloatQuery: the three adjacent fields (0x2C/0x30/0x34) are likely a contiguous triple, but whether they are floats, vectors or scalars is not evidenced.

FlagBitState: the meaning of the two cleared flag bits (which state they reset) is not evidenced; the field at this+0x3C is reported recalculated every frame by a fill, but that persistence claim is not independently verified here.
FloatStructTableInit: the purpose of the 256-entry table at unk_8BF740 and the significance of the 26-DWORD stride are unknown.

Mesh: the two physics globals (0x0059E440, 0x0059E450) are attributed by the packet but do not appear in the visible raw source; the device vtable at dword_8B8F24 and the frame-delta source at dword_8B8F28 have external, unrecoverable contracts.

Mesh: the flag bits controlling static vs blended vertex paths, primitive dispatch, and clock clamping are not named; the vertex data layout at part+12 and destination buffer at part+32 is inferred from the copy pattern; the full animation-frame layout behind this+0x144 is not established.

MeshPartProcessingCallbacks: the global read of dword_8B78A0 recorded in the fact table is absent from both raw wrapper bodies and is unexplained; the identity and owner of ConditionalFieldSetter_0d40 / ConditionalBitmaskCleanup are outside this packet.

SceneRenderBatch: this+0x1E4 and this+0x2EC/0x2F0/0x2F4 are not visible in the raw source (the latter possibly a scene camera-position triplet); global flt_59E440 is folded out of the raw source and is likely a float bias/epsilon; the dword_8B8F24 service identity is unresolved.

SceneRenderBatch/RenderListManager/RenderBufferEntryManager/NetworkPacketReader: all read this+0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8 but treat them as different descriptor types (render descriptor, element count/array, packet handle). Equal offsets on different objects are kept as separate fields; common ownership is not proven.

RenderListManager: the second parameter a2 is unused; the two indirect calls through dword_8B8F24 slot +4 have no callee entries; the meaning of the 29-dword element stride and the this+69 context pointer is unresolved.

NetworkPacketReader: this+0x1E4 and this+0x1E8 are not exercised in the raw decompiled source; the present-flag bit 0 and the 116-byte entry layout beyond +0x34 are inferred; the 64-byte payload type and packet-buffer ownership model are not established.

RenderBufferEntryManager: the raw source reaches the entry array through the descriptor's +8 pointer while this+0x1E8 is modeled as the array; the 0x8000000 bulk sentinel and the status field at +0x40 semantics are not established.
WorkingIndexHolder: the stored field meaning (material slot index vs vertex processing counter) is DERIVED from caller names only.

MeshDataDualFormat: exact element semantics of sub_550810 (0x00550810) and ArrayOfStructDestructorWithCountdown (0x00550820) are not grounded; the allocator header convention (element count at allocation minus 4) is inferred.

ParameterTableConsumer: the parameter table layout (pointer this+0x1C, entry-table base at +0x2C, count at +0x30, 44-byte per-type entries at base +40, 32 dwords per data index) is inferred from index arithmetic; sub_53B4C0's copy width and the block slot meanings (+4..+12, +52..+60) are not established.

FlagTimerOwner: TimerStartViaQueryPerformanceCounter is referenced only by name in the raw source and is absent from the packet callees; the meaning of flag bit 0x2000 and the region cleared by mask 0xFFFE0FFF is unknown.
